notes: All 9 exams (7 required + both optional items: a-levels-music and ib-visual-arts) were researched on 2026-11-17 from live sources; every topic line below was extracted from a source actually fetched in this pass (official PDF/page or a mirror marked as such). No URL was invented: unreachable official URLs appear as sources only where they were discovered on pages that were fetched (upsc.gov.in homepage, Cambridge subject page) or via the one working search route.

Sandbox network constraints, recorded honestly: this environment had no usable general search engine (Google 429, Bing serving unrelated junk, DuckDuckGo/Brave/Startpage/searx.be bot-blocked); the only working search was the SearXNG instance search.inetol.net rendered in a headless browser, which is how the madeeasy mirror of the UPSC ESE notice and the NID/IB mirror pages were located. Direct curl fetches worked for ugcnetonline.in, uceed.iitb.ac.in, cbseacademic.nic.in, cambridgeinternational.org, admissions.nid.edu (curl needed -k due to a sandbox CA issue) and madeeasy.in.

UGC NET subject syllabi (Performing Arts code 65, Visual Art code 79, Music code 16) are the official UGC NET Bureau syllabus PDFs ('NTA_All_R_Syllabus') served from the UGC NET portal ugcnetonline.in via its syllabus index page; the index page itself was fetched to discover the exact PDF paths.

ugc-net-performing-arts: the syllabus states Units 1-5 are common to Dance and Drama/Theatre, while Units 6-10 exist twice - once for DANCE and once for DRAMA/THEATRE - so both sets are recorded with 'Dance:' and 'Drama/Theatre:' prefixes to keep the lines distinct.

ugc-net-music: the syllabus states Units I-IV are common to all in music and Units V-X are subject-specific; the four subject-specific blocks are Hindustani (Vocal, Instrumental & Musicology), Karnataka, Percussion and Rabindra Sangeet. Hindustani and Karnataka Units V-X are recorded one line per unit; Percussion and Rabindra Sangeet are recorded as two condensed blocks (their unit titles are listed within each line) to keep the ledger at unit/topic-area granularity.
ugc-net-visual-arts: 10 common units plus five electives exactly as stated (Art History; Drawing and Painting; Applied Art; Printmaking (Graphic Art); Sculpture).

nata: nata.in sits behind a bot challenge that blocked both curl and the headless browser (homepage and brochure PDF alike), so the official brochure PDF could not be fetched from this sandbox; the test areas below were taken from the PhysicsWallah (pw.live) mirror of the official CoA brochure structure (Part A Drawing & Composition 80 marks; Part B Aptitude & Mathematics 120 marks, MCQ+NCQ). The official brochure URL is still listed as a source because it was discovered via the working search instance, with this caveat in the notes.
uceed: topic lines are verbatim from the official UCEED 2027 syllabus page at IIT Bombay (Part-A: seven topics; Part-B: two topics).

nid-dat: the official NID Admissions Handbook 2027-28 (B.Des/5.5-year integrated pathway, published 10 September 2026) states the two-stage DAT structure (DAT Prelims pen-and-paper test with questions that 'may involve text and visuals'; DAT Mains consisting of a Studio Sensitivity Test and an In-Person Sensitivity Test) but publishes NO topic list; the typical content areas of recent Prelims papers are recorded from the AglaSem mirror and are marked as such in the lines.

cbse-fine-arts: the official Classes XI-XII Fine Arts curriculum document (subject codes 049-052, 2026-27) covers four subjects (Painting, Graphics, Sculpture, Applied Art/Commercial Art) whose THEORY syllabus is common across all four; theory units are recorded once, and each subject's distinct practical units are recorded per subject, per class where they differ.

a-levels-music: Cambridge International AS & A Level Music 9483, current syllabus for exams in 2027 and 2028 (version 4) from the official syllabus PDF; the five assessment components are recorded as the syllabus states them (A Level candidates take Paper 1, Component 2 and two of Components 3/4/5).

ib-visual-arts: chosen as the syllabus-stable IB arts subject (three-component portfolio structure unchanged since first assessment 2017). ibo.org is Cloudflare-blocked (403) for both curl and headless browser, so the structure was taken from two independent mirrors (ibcourses.net, fetched in full; RevisionDojo, fetched in full and agreeing on the three components and SL/HL split), following the same approach the physics ledger used for IB Physics.
Granularity: unit/topic-area level as each syllabus states it; sub-lines after an em-dash condense the syllabus's own sub-bullets and are not invented.

The 2026-11-17 swarm-reorganisation pass deduplicated/moved the planned lessons the lines witnessed; the affected lines were re-routed to the books that now own their topics (re-scored live, >=0.60 standard).

The 2026-11-17 swarm-reorg witness pass: lines whose witnesses were removed as junk/duplicates regained clean-titled witness lessons in their owning chapters; paper-structure furniture lines (marks/CBT/MCQ asides) were dropped as non-topics (the deliberately-excluded precedent).
Final 2026-11-17 swarm-reorg reconciliation: lines re-evaluated against the post-witness registry; honest home re-routes applied.
